title: Currently Avoiding Something Shirt, Dry Office Humor Tee, Funny Work T-Shirt, Coworker Gift
description:
Currently avoiding something.

This minimalist text shirt delivers dry workplace humor without explaining the joke. Featuring the expression “Currently Avoiding Something,” it’s made for procrastinators, remote workers, introverts, office employees, and anyone expertly postponing a task they should probably be doing.

A funny and understated gift for coworkers, office friends, employees, work-from-home professionals, or anyone with a deeply committed relationship with avoidance.

PRODUCT FEATURES

• Gildan 5000 Heavy Cotton T-shirt
• Classic unisex fit
• Medium-weight 180 g/m² fabric
• Solid colors are 100% cotton
• Tubular construction with no side seams
• Ribbed knit collar helps retain its shape
• Shoulder tape provides additional stability
• Tear-away label for added comfort
• Crisp direct-to-garment printed text
• OEKO-TEX® certified
• Made using ethically sourced US cotton

FIT AND SIZING

This is a classic-fit shirt, not an oversized or boxy tee. Please review the size chart before ordering.

• Order your usual size for a classic fit
• Size up one size for a looser, more relaxed fit
• Size up two sizes for an oversized appearance

CARE INSTRUCTIONS

• Machine wash cold, maximum 30°C or 90°F
• Tumble dry on low heat
• Use non-chlorine bleach only when needed
• Do not iron
• Do not dry clean

MADE TO ORDER

This shirt is printed especially for you after your order is placed. Slight variations in color and print placement may occur due to differences between screens and the printing process.

Designed by HomeFromWorking and professionally printed, packaged, and shipped by a production partner.
